At NCAB Group, our people make us unique. We combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture, helping customers around the world make better business through high-quality PCB solutions.
As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Key Account Manager to join our team in Stockholm and help bring our vision, Making PCBs Easy, to life. You will be part of a highly engaged organization and have the opportunity to work with customers in industries such as Aerospace, Datacom, Industrial, Medical, Railway and Telecom.
We are looking for a Key Account Manager to drive profitable growth, strengthen customer relationships, and develop new business in Stockholm, Sweden. This role combines hands-on sales, strategic account development, and close collaboration with internal teams to deliver high-quality PCB solutions to demanding customers.
Your Responsibilities at a Glance 
Develop and grow sales across Sweden by strengthening existing customer relationships and identifying new business opportunities.
Build long-term customer relationships and position NCAB as a trusted partner for high-quality PCB solutions.
Manage the sales pipeline and customer portfolio, including quotations, negotiations, forecasts and KPI follow-up.
Monitor market trends and customer needs to identify growth opportunities and support local sales activities.
Work closely with Engineering, Inside Sales, Quality, Logistics and our international suppliers to deliver strong solutions for our customers.
Contribute to sales excellence, knowledge sharing and internal projects that strengthen NCAB’s market presence.

We’re looking for you 
You are a commercially driven and customer-focused sales professional who enjoys building long-term relationships while identifying new business opportunities. You combine a proactive mindset with a structured approach to business development.
Proven sales experience, ideally within a technical or industrial environment such as electronics, PCB or EMS
Strong skills in solution selling, negotiation, pipeline management and forecasting.
Self-driven, trustworthy and hands-on, with a collaborative mindset and clear communication style.
Fluent in Swedish and English, with willingness to travel within the region.

Our Values
Our shared values Quality First, Strong Relationships, Full Responsibility shape our culture and guide how we think, act and work together.
Ready for your next challenge? We'd love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and application in English as soon as possible.
We're meeting candidates continuously, so the role may be filled sooner than expected. If you're interested, we'd love to hear from you as soon as possible.
If you have any questions please feel to reach out to Sales Manager Sweden Ludvig.Lindqvist@ncabgroup.com at or People and Culture Manager Maria.sundstrom@ncabgroup.com

 Vi söker dig som är trygg, tydlig och har en god förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer. Du är strukturerad i ditt arbete, har ett lösningsfokuserat förhållningssätt och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team. 

Du ingår i skolans elevhälsoteam (EHT), där vi arbetar nära tillsammans med ett tydligt fokus på förebyggande och hälsofrämjande insatser. Du samarbetar dagligen med skolledning, lärare och övrig personal för att skapa en positiv läromiljö präglad av studiero, tydlighet och höga förväntningar.

jobs.occupation: Quality Impression Feature Engineer / Feature Leader
jobs.description:
Quality Impression Feature Engineer / Feature Leader
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Employment type: Contract / Full-time
Language: English
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Quality Impression Feature Engineer / Feature Leader to join our client's team in Gothenburg.
In this assignment, you will play an important role in developing and improving the Quality Impression feature for Heavy Duty Vehicles. You will be responsible for defining requirements, evaluating feature status and supporting product development throughout different project phases.
You will also contribute to the long-term development of the feature by improving test methods, supporting simulation activities and contributing to roadmap planning.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with an automotive or product development background who is interested in quality, design perception and vehicle engineering.
Key Responsibilities
Handle, define and coordinate requirements related to the Quality Impression feature.

Perform verification, evaluation and testing of models and physical products for Heavy Duty Vehicles.

Assess and monitor feature status throughout different project phases.

Provide technical feedback and collaborate with cross-functional engineering and product development teams.

Drive the development and continuous improvement of feature definitions, methods and processes.

Contribute to the long-term feature strategy and roadmap planning.

Support the development and improvement of test methods and simulation activities.

Prepare and communicate feature status reports to project stakeholders.

Represent the Quality Impression area in discussions and technical reviews.

Required Qualifications
Educational background in Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Development or a related technical field.

Experience in automotive engineering, industrial design or product development.

Understanding of product quality evaluation and development processes.

Experience in requirements handling, verification, evaluation or testing.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience in Quality Impression or Perceived Quality.

Experience working with Heavy Duty Vehicles or the automotive industry.

Knowledge of CAE (Computer-Aided Engineering).

Experience with visualization techniques and 3D rendering.

Experience with simulation activities and product evaluation.

Experience in feature development, roadmap planning and cross-functional project work.

Personal Attributes
We are looking for someone who is:
Curious, analytical and solution-oriented.

Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.

Confident in communicating technical topics and representing their area.

Collaborative, supportive and open-minded.

Able to work effectively with different teams and stakeholders.

Focused on continuous improvement and delivering high-quality results.

Interested in This Opportunity?
If you have experience in automotive product development, quality evaluation or feature engineering and would like to contribute to the development of Heavy Duty Vehicles, we would be happy to hear from you.
Please submit your updated CV along with a brief description of your relevant experience.

jobs.occupation: Polish-Speaking babysitter / nanny in Sundbyberg – 2 afternoons per week
jobs.description:
Since 2008, Solidum Sverige AB / Barnakademin has helped families across Sweden find reliable, caring babysitters. We offer creative childcare in Swedish and specialize in bilingual babysitting, helping children develop their language skills naturally through play and everyday activities.
About the Position
We are looking for a caring, responsible, and enthusiastic Polish-speaking babysitter for a family in Sundbyberg, with two children aged 3 and 6.
The family needs regular help 2 afternoons per week, from 15:00 to 18:00 (6 hours per week). The role involves picking up the children from preschool/school, bringing them home safely, and spending the afternoon together until their parents return.
The family would like their children to maintain and develop their Polish language skills, so we are looking for someone who enjoys speaking Polish with children and making the language a natural part of everyday activities.
Your responsibilities will include:
Picking up the children from preschool/school and accompanying them home safely
Organizing fun, creative, and age-appropriate activities
Playing, reading, singing, and communicating with the children in Polish
Helping with simple afternoon routines and snacks
Creating a warm, safe, and positive environment for the children

Who We're Looking For
We would love to hear from you if you:
Speak Polish at a native or fluent level
Communicate confidently in English or Swedish
Have previous experience caring for children, professionally or privately
Are responsible, reliable, patient, and genuinely enjoy spending time with children
Enjoy creative play, outdoor activities, and engaging children in learning
Are available 2 weekdays per week, from 15:00 to 18:00
Can commit to the position until at least summer 2027

This position is particularly suitable for university students or anyone looking for a rewarding part-time job alongside their studies or other commitments.
What We Offer
A regular part-time position with a family in Sundbyberg
A supportive and friendly working environment
Ongoing guidance and support from our central office
A welcoming community of fellow babysitters
Written references at the end of your employment
Opportunities for additional babysitting assignments with other families
Valuable experience working with children in a bilingual environment

Available Only One Afternoon per Week?
We still encourage you to apply! Even if you cannot commit to both afternoons, we may have other families looking for Polish-speaking babysitters whose schedules match your availability.
Apply Today!
If you love working with children and would enjoy helping them grow up with the Polish language, we would be happy to hear from you!
Please submit your application in English or Swedish, including a brief description of your childcare experience, language skills, and availability.
We look forward to welcoming you to Barnakademin!

About this vacancy

 

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) är en internationell skolmiljö där engagerade medarbetare arbetar tillsammans för att skapa trygghet, studiero och goda förutsättningar för lärande.

IES Värmdö är en F–9-skola med cirka 610 elever och 68 medarbetare. Skolan ligger i Charlottendal, Gustavsberg, med goda kommunikationer från Stockholm.

Vi söker nu en Student Care Coordinator (SCC) för ett vikariat på ett år, med möjlighet till förlängning. Tillträde är den 11 januari 2027.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som Student Care Coordinator arbetar du nära skolledning och elevhälsoteam för att främja elevernas trygghet, välbefinnande och utveckling. Du är en synlig och aktiv vuxen i skolmiljön och arbetar med elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 9.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

- Samordna, följa upp och dokumentera stödinsatser för elever.
- Arbeta förebyggande med trygghet, studiero, närvaro och socialt välbefinnande.
- Stödja elever med sociala, psykosociala och beteendemässiga behov.
- Samarbeta med elevhälsoteam, skolledning, lärare och vårdnadshavare.
- Bidra till skolans arbete mot kränkande behandling och genomföra informations- och utbildningsinsatser.
- Vara närvarande i skolans olika miljöer och bidra till en trygg och positiv skolvardag.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du har god förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor och trivs i en internationell och föränderlig skolmiljö.

Vi ser att du har:

- God kunskap om skolans styrdokument och relevant skollagstiftning.
- Erfarenhet eller god kunskap om elevhälsoarbete och förebyggande insatser.
- Förståelse för arbetet med trygghet, studiero och kränkande behandling.
- God förmåga att samarbeta och kommunicera med elever, vårdnadshavare och externa aktörer.
- Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Vi erbjuder

- En internationell och stödjande arbetsmiljö.
- Engagerade kollegor och ett nära samarbete med skolledning och elevhälsa.
- Möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad i elevernas vardag och skolgång.

Ansökan

Skicka ditt CV och personliga brev till recruitment.varmdo@engelska.se.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, kontakta maria.segerstedt.varmdo@engelska.se.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.description:

Teaching is through both Swedish and English, with English the language of the corridors. IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at "Grundskolan" with 43 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993. IES Eskilstuna is one of the largest schools in Sweden with 1,185 students enrolled in grades F-9 and approx 125 staff members.
Vill du arbeta med barn och unga och göra skillnad i deras vardag? IES Eskilstuna söker engagerade och ansvarstagande timvikarier till vår grundskola för årskurs 4-9.Som timvikarie hos oss får du ett varierande och meningsfullt arbete där du stöttar verksamheten vid ordinarie personals frånvaro. Vikariera för lärare vid frånvaro

Ansvara för undervisning utifrån planering från ordinarie personal

Skapa trygghet, struktur och studiero i klassrummet

Bidra till en trygg och stimulerande lärmiljö under lektioner och raster

Samarbeta med kollegor

Vara behjälplig vid inom- och utomhusaktiviteter

Detta är en fantastisk möjlighet att få erfarenhet av att arbeta i en tvåspråkig miljö och utvecklas inom skolans värld! 
KVALIFIKATIONERVi söker dig som är flexibel och kan hoppa in som timvikarie med kort varsel. Du har avslutad gymnasieutbildning och erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn och ungdomar. Det är meriterande om du tidigare arbetat på skola eller grundskola, studerar till fritidsledare/lärare i fritidshemmet eller har relevant utbildning inom området. 
Som person är du ansvarsfull och tycker om att ta egna initiativ. Du har ett tydligt elevfokus. Arbetet som timvikarie består av många möten och det är därför av stor vikt att du har en positiv människosyn och en god samarbetsförmåga. Framförallt har du ett brinnande intresse för barn och ungdomars lärande och utveckling.

Brinner för att arbeta med barn och ungdomar

Är trygg, flexibel och ansvarstagande

Har ett positivt bemötande och god samarbetsförmåga

Kan leda grupper och skapa god ordning

Kan skapa goda relationer med våra elever, personal och vårdnadshavare

Kan bidra till arbetsro i elevgrupp och i klassrummet

Har goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska, både i tal och skrift

Anställningsformen är timanställning vid behov, med start så snart som möjligt.
För att arbeta hos oss krävs att du ska ha fyllt 18 år och du behöver ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret, ansök via länken.https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/ 
Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.
Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via email.
Välkommen med din ansökan!

Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
We are recruiting a Researcher to work primarily in the European Plate Observing System (EPOS) project related to developing research infrastructure to archive and access geoscientific data. You will also be involved in other projects as well teaching Exploration geophysics courses. Take the opportunity to work in interdisciplinary, dynamic, international research environment in close collaboration with industry and leading universities worldwide.
 
 
Subject description 
 
Applied Geophysics includes studies of how the laws and methods of physics can be used to understand the properties of bedrock and soil deposits. This includes development and applications of methods for exploration and investigation of natural resources such as mineral deposits and water, as well as investigation of environmental and infrastructural related issues.
 
 
Project description
 
The pan-European “European Plate Observing System (EPOS)” distributed e-infrastructure is a long-term sustainable solution for the collection, securing, dissemination and analysis of data related to the solid Earth and the processes forming the solid Earth and surface.  One of the core services of the project is Geoelectromagnetic observations Thematic Core Service TCS. TCS Geoelectromanetic Observations is responsible for the provision of data about the geomagnetic field between the Earth’s core and space. The EMTDAMO (the European Service of Magnetotluric Data and Models) service was introduced for data that determine the electrical resistivity of the Earth’s subsurface by measuring the response on natural time variations of the Earth's magnetic and electric fields. Luleå University of Technology is responsible for EMTDAMO, which will collect data from various sources as the basis for new and improved resistivity models of the Earth.
 
 
Duties
 
Within the EPOS project you will be working on archiving of EM data, which involves development and management of databases. A big part of your working time will be devoted to project and data management and communication with TCS partners. The position responsibilities also include both field work (to collect new data) and theoretical/development work as well as communicating your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. You will work primarily with electromagnetic data with focus on magnetotelluric observations. 3D geophysical data modelling/inversion is also important element of work duties, especially when being involved in other projects run at Luleå University of Technology. You are expected to work on our in-house development of modelling/inversion framework. In addition, you will have to teacher courses as well as co-supervise PhD students. As a researcher, you work as a neutral party in many contexts, which provides a great opportunity to be involved in challenging development projects.
 
 
Qualifications 
 
In order to be eligible for employment as a Researcher you must have a PhD or equivalent degree in Geophysics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or another relevant field, awarded no more than three years before the application deadline for this position. You must also have an academic record, experience in software development (Python, Matlab and Web development in particular) and management of large data sets are required. Good understanding of theory and numerical methods used in modelling and inversion are important. You are expected to work in a team and are open to collaborate with colleagues and external partners. Fluent written and spoken English is required.
 
 
Most employees in the research subject exploration geophysics are currently men therefore provided that the qualifications are the same, the underrepresented gender will be given priority.
 
 
Further information
 
This employment as Researcher is set to 75% and is limited to 1 year. Placement: Luleå. Starting date: 2027-01-01 or as soon as possible.
 
 
For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Maxim Smirnov, Associate Professor, (+46) 920-493413, mailto:maxim.smirnov@ltu.se
